subject: Your 68 days of dates unlocked something
preview_text: We noticed you've been using SoulPlan for 68 days. Here's a personal thank you and something we don't give to everyone.
body_paragraphs: I won't bury the lede: you're one of the first 200 couples to hit 68 days with SoulPlan, and we owe you a real thank you. Not a generic 'thanks for being a user' line—I mean it. Every time you open the app, you're telling us that planning a date matters more than letting another Thursday slip by. That's rare, and it deserves more than a notification.

Here's what most people don't see: we've been quietly tracking what makes couples stick together long-term. Your streak, your memory timeline entries, the way you both use Tonight's Date—it's not just data to us. It's proof that small, consistent gestures beat grand plans every time. And because you've stayed this long, you've earned something we don't advertise.

Starting now, you have exclusive access to a hidden feature: the Anniversary Jar's 'vintage mode.' It pulls from your own wishlist and the community's most-loved dates to suggest something you'd never think of—but your partner will love. No one else sees this. Not the new users, not the ones who quit after a week. Just you, because you showed up for 68 days.

Open SoulPlan now, tap your profile, and look for the golden key icon next to your streak. That's your entry. One tap, and the jar will serve you a surprise you can send tonight. P.S. The golden key expires in 48 hours—not because we're being pushy, but because exclusivity only works if it's real. You earned it. Use it.
